b'# tinydl

A simple CLI tool to download files from URLs.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <URL> [--options]
```

## Command Line Options

| Option | Type | Help Text |
|---------|------|------------|
| `<url>` | positional | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | optional | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | flag | no progress output |
'
